record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Polyomino Tilings
record.original_question: The order of a polyomino is the minimum number of copies of that polyomino needed to tile a rectangle. Does there exist a polyomino whose order is exactly 5?

evidence.quote: Klarner [25] defined the order of a polyomino to be the minimum number of copies that can tile a rectangle.
It is also known that no polyomino has order 3 [36]. This leaves a fairly wide open spectrum of possible orders which may or may not be realized by polyominoes, the smallest of which is 5
Open Problem 11 Is there a polyomino of order 5?

artifact.self_contained_problem: A polyomino is a finite, edge-connected union of unit squares in the integer lattice (taken up to translation, rotation, and reflection). Given a polyomino P, its order is defined as the minimum positive integer n, if it exists, such that n congruent copies of P (allowing translations, rotations, and reflections, with disjoint interiors) can be assembled to tile some rectangle. It is known that no polyomino has order 3, while polyominoes of orders 1, 2, 4, and various larger values exist. Determine whether there exists a polyomino whose order is exactly 5; that is, a polyomino P such that 5 congruent copies of P can tile some rectangle but no rectangle can be tiled by fewer than 5 copies of P.
artifact.status_search_result: No polyomino of order 5 is known. Surveys on polyomino tilings (e.g., the Handbook of Discrete and Computational Geometry chapter on polyominoes, and Erich Friedman's pages) report orders 1, 2, 4, and many larger values realized while order 3 is impossible; the existence of any polyomino of order 5 (and indeed of any odd order greater than 1) remains an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Polyominoes (Handbook chapter)
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of the order of polyominoes; orders 1, 2, 4, and various higher values are realized; order 3 is impossible.
status_evidence.claim: The existence of polyominoes of order 5 is not established in the standard survey on polyomino tilings.

status_evidence.title: Polyomino — Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: No polyomino of odd order greater than 1 is known.
status_evidence.claim: It remains unknown whether any polyomino has order 5.
